name: Chunk 1/32

raw_entities.name: Fraud Prevention Policy
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's formal fraud prevention policy governing the identification, investigation, and mitigation of fraud risks across all customer accounts and banking products. The policy is owned by the Head of Financial Crime and applies to all staff, financial crime, risk, and retail banking functions. Effective from 2026-01-15 with annual review scheduled for 2027-01-15.
context: Audience | All Staff, Financial Crime, Risk, Retail Banking

raw_entities.name: Head of Financial Crime
raw_entities.description: The executive role responsible for ownership and governance of the Fraud Prevention Policy at FirstUK Bank. This role holds accountability for policy implementation, compliance, and periodic review.

raw_entities.name: All Staff
raw_entities.description: All employees of FirstUK Bank are identified as an audience for the Fraud Prevention Policy, indicating universal applicability of fraud prevention obligations and awareness requirements across the organisation.
context: Audience | All Staff, Financial Crime, Risk, Retail Banking

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Department
raw_entities.description: The department within FirstUK Bank responsible for administering and enforcing the Fraud Prevention Policy. This department is identified as both the policy owner department and a key audience for policy implementation.
context: Audience | All Staff, Financial Crime, Risk, Retail Banking

raw_entities.name: FCA COBS
raw_entities.description: Financial Conduct Authority Conduct of Business rules that form the regulatory basis for FirstUK Bank's Fraud Prevention Policy. COBS establishes conduct standards and customer protection requirements applicable to the bank's fraud prevention obligations.
context: Regulatory Reference | FCA COBS, Payment Services Regulations 2017

raw_entities.name: Payment Services Regulations 2017
raw_entities.description: UK legislation governing payment services and fraud liability that forms the regulatory basis for FirstUK Bank's Fraud Prevention Policy. The PSR 2017 establishes requirements for fraud prevention, customer liability, and payment security.
context: Regulatory Reference | FCA COBS, Payment Services Regulations 2017

raw_entities.name: Fraud
raw_entities.description: The primary risk category addressed by FirstUK Bank's Fraud Prevention Policy. Fraud encompasses unauthorised transactions, account takeover, payment fraud, and other deceptive activities that threaten customer assets and bank integrity.
